fire: Thirty sarcomas were resected at our centre between 2005 and 2015.
Positive surgical margins were linked with worse survival.
Local recurrence was common after surgery for rectal cancer.
Complete resection of the primary tumour remains the main goal.
Primary surgical treatment is preferred for early ovarian cancer.
Patients who underwent lymphadenectomy had longer survival.
The liver metastases were removed by surgical resection in most cases.
We studied long-term outcomes after surgery for lung cancer.
quiet: Thirty sarcomas were treated with radiation at our centre between 2005 and 2015.
Positive lymph nodes were linked with worse survival.
Local recurrence was common after chemotherapy for rectal cancer.
Complete remission of the primary tumour remains the main goal.
Primary drug treatment is preferred for early ovarian cancer.
Patients who received immunotherapy had longer survival.
The liver scans were read by a radiologist in most cases.
We studied long-term outcomes after screening for lung cancer.
